notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to draw a card.
"Insect" chosen with Engineered Plague.
description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
The Insect enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Liliana triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.
